all_density_rise_candidates.width_interpretation: Numerical profile crossings, not physical shock thickness; broad half-height widths may include the declining initial cloud envelope.

endpoint_features.interpretation: Operational native-grid candidates; density peaks are not identified as termination shocks. Missing, injection-adjacent and unresolved features are excluded from surrogate eligibility.
endpoint_features.fit_eligibility_reason: No approved surrogate; single survey mesh. Missing or unresolved physical features require independent review and refinement.

mass_definition: Gas from r>=0.001 pc, excluding the star. Positive density-excess mass is Eulerian, not a tracer-defined swept mass.
width_definition: 10--90 crossings of the local density rise and envelope half-height crossings; fractional native cell counts. No physical thickness or convergence claim.
